description: All workflow files that commit/push declare permissions: contents: write
steps: Audit every .github/workflows/*.yml
Add permissions block where missing
Use the minimum permission level needed

description: Action SHAs pinned where major-version pins have caused download failures
steps: Identify actions in daily_dossier.yml that failed download (configure-pages@v5)
Pin those to a known-good SHA or add a fallback step
Document the version map in a comment

description: Daily Alpha Dossier retries the action-download step once on transient failure
steps: Wrap the action-download-sensitive job in a retry mechanism
Use nick-fields/retry or built-in step retry pattern
Confirm it triggers on AC10 codeload errors

description: New workflow opens or updates a GitHub Issue when any scheduled workflow fails
steps: Create .github/workflows/notify_failure.yml
Trigger on workflow_run completed with conclusion == failure
Use peter-evans/create-or-update-issue or gh cli to file under label 'pipeline-failure'
Idempotent: one open issue per workflow, comment on existing instead of duplicating

description: TickerTrace client surfaces failures instead of swallowing them
steps: Inspect dossier/data_sources/tickertrace.py
When _get fails after retries, return a sentinel that the report can render as 'TickerTrace unavailable'
Log the failure to stderr with the actual URL it tried so the next debug is one-click

description: Daily Alpha Dossier preflight step pings api.tickertrace.pro before running the pipeline
steps: Add a 'Check external deps' step in daily_dossier.yml
curl -fsS https://api.tickertrace.pro/api/v1/stats and continue-on-error: true
Log result so it's visible in the run summary

description: Leveraged screener daily.html shows its own freshness banner
steps: In dossier/data_sources/leveraged_daily_screener.py, inject a 'Generated YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC' line at the top of the rendered HTML
Add JS or inline-rendered staleness: if generation date < today UTC, show a red banner saying 'STALE: last refresh was N days ago'
No new asset deps — inline CSS only

description: Runbook doc — when a workflow fails, do these things in this order
steps: Write docs/runbooks/pipeline-failure.md
Cover: gh run view, common failure modes (403, codeload, SSL), where each workflow's outputs land
Link from AGENTS.md 'Common Gotchas'
Append: workflows that push need permissions: contents: write
Append: TICKERTRACE_API_BASE is https://api.tickertrace.pro (no /api suffix)
Append: codeload.github.com sometimes 503s; rerun the workflow once before debugging

description: Manual verification — all touched workflows pass workflow_dispatch run
steps: gh workflow run for each modified workflow
Confirm green
Confirm leveraged-screener/daily.html banner renders on next dossier run
